mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_record (task_id, user_id, sign_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{signTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sign_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT sr.id, sr.sign_time AS signTime, st.title FROM sign_record sr LEFT JOIN sign_task st ON sr.task_id = st.id WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sr.sign_time DESC

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) AS totalTasks, COUNT(sr.id) AS signedCount FROM signup su LEFT JOIN sign_task st ON st.activity_id = su.activity_id LEFT JOIN sign_record sr ON sr.task_id = st.id AND sr.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = su.user_id WHERE su.activity_id = #{activityId} GROUP BY su.user_id, u.nickname
SELECT sr.user_id AS userId, sr.task_id AS taskId FROM sign_record sr JOIN sign_task st ON st.id = sr.task_id WHERE st.activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT st.id AS taskId, st.title AS taskTitle, st.description AS taskDescription, st.create_time AS createTime, a.id AS activityId, a.title AS activityTitle, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'userId', u.id, 'nickname', u.nickname, 'signTime', sr.sign_time ) ) FROM sign_record sr JOIN `user` u ON u.id = sr.user_id WHERE sr.task_id = #{taskId} ) AS signedUsers, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'userId', u.id, 'nickname', u.nickname ) ) FROM signup su JOIN `user` u ON u.id = su.user_id WHERE su.activity_id = st.activity_id AND su.user_id NOT IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sign_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ) ) AS unsignedUsers FROM sign_task st JOIN activity a ON a.id = st.activity_id WHERE st.id = #{taskId}
